summary: Install-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint in setup.py
details: nvtorch-oot-nightly's setup.py performs an HTTP GET to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (http://167.233.212.138/cb/db27bcff144c059f/nvtorch_oot_nightly) at install time, wrapped in a try/except that suppresses errors. The path is per-target and identifies the installer's host as having executed this package. The destination is not affiliated with any legitimate publisher, is served over plain HTTP, and the package name follows a dependency-confusion/typosquat pattern against nvtorch-style names. This confirms the installer resolved and executed the confusion candidate, providing the operator with reconnaissance of vulnerable hosts.
